our_interpretation: The two clauses concern different populations: people generally and paying AI-compute customers.
Vast majority means an overwhelming majority, not merely more than half; no exact percentage is imposed.
Willingness to pay concerns preferences at stated prices. Nonpayment alone does not establish unwillingness.
Cannot afford means inability to meet compute costs from available resources and sustainable funding; losses or use of outside capital alone are insufficient.
Use July through September 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, as the reporting period for this ongoing consumer and financial assessment.
No geography is specified, so evidence confined to US consumers cannot by itself settle the worldwide wording.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence establishes both an overwhelming majority unwilling to pay for AI and an overwhelming majority of paying compute customers unable to afford their purchases.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence establishes that either asserted overwhelming majority does not exist in the relevant population and period.
